result.summary: Several visual issues including a broken/missing restaurant image placeholder, truncated restaurant names, and incomplete category filter chips.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card under 'Popular right now' shows a broken image placeholder (mountain icon) instead of a restaurant photo, leaving a large empty gray area.
issues.suggestion: Load the correct restaurant image or provide a proper fallback illustration so the card is not visually empty.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with missing letters at the end of the 'Fastest near you' row.
issues.suggestion: Allow the name to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or truncate with an ellipsis so the full name is readable on tap/hover.

issues.description: The category filter chips row is cut off on the right (partial chip visible after 'Healthy'), suggesting horizontal overflow without clear affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure chips scroll cleanly with padding/fade indicator, or fit the full set without clipping.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promo image is partially cut off by the bottom navigation bar, making the card look incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/margin above the tab bar so full cards are visible when scrolling.
